we identified a mutation in the X-linked retinitis pigmentos GTPase regulator (RPGR) gene in a family with a complex phenotype of retinitis pigmentosis and primary ciliary dyskenesia.
we found that RPGR mutations are responsible for a complex X linked syndrome combining PCD and RP, which is the first clear evidence that PCD can be transmitted as an X linked disease.
